title: Gur-e-Amir, Samarkand
summary: Gur-e-Amir is a Timurid mausoleum complex in Samarkand, built in 1400–1404 by Timur for his grandson Muhammad Sultan, who died in battle in 1403. It later became the burial place of Timur and his male descendants and has a ribbed, tiled double-shell dome.

uncertainty.note: The University of New Hampshire site gives 1400-1404; MIT OpenCourseWare dates the building to 1404.

importance.justification: MIT course notes treat it as a major Timurid mausoleum that became the burial place of Timur and his male descendants.
